items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I was speaking about the Mo clothing store... that was (All Roth's?) band but he didn't have none of Dickerson's boys in that.

ctx.x: I was speaking about the Mo clothing store. And that's why I say we were one of the first black bands to have a commercial. In New York City. And that was (All Roth's?) band but he didn't have none of Dickerson's boys in that.
